findings.title: Phones prefetch 10-20 MB of extra pages on every page view (Wix eager speculation rules) - known-open item, exact source + working fix
findings.symptom: Every core page that carries the rule transferred 10.9-23.3 MB per phone load (e.g. / 23,883 KB @320 and 17,731 KB @390; /contact 11,626 KB @390; /about 12.9-16.8 MB; an EMPTY search page 11.8-12.3 MB). 83% of /contact (9,644 of 11,626 KB, 45 requests) is other pages' HTML being prefetched, ~450-500 KB compressed each. The same URL is fetched 3-8 times in one view (on /: 8x roster post, 8x /gatorbait-media-blogs, 6x /the-buddy-martin-show, 4x /magazine, 4x /policies). The three pages without the rule weigh 2.4-3.8 MB (/pricing-plans/subscribe 2,630 KB, /tags 2,489 KB). This answers the /contact question: desktop only prefetches on hover, phones prefetch every link that scrolls into view.
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/contact-390.json (hosts: gatorbaitmedia.com 45req/9644KB; biggest = ten 'Prefetch' docs of 491-499 KB); /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/home-320.json (gatorbaitmedia.com 79req/19711KB, duplicates list); rule text + injecting script captured in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/d3/contact-390.json (custom.specCtxBefore); link churn in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/d2/contact-390.json (custom.ancInserted: /the-buddy-martin-show anchors removed 10x, /magazine 6x); staged fix results in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/d14/contact-390.json and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/d14/home-390.json
findings.cause: It is Wix's own platform script, not a GBM embed: an inline <script> in <head> placed right after Wix's isSamePageAnchor script and before <style id=css_masterPage> (i.e. before the 'pageHtmlEmbeds.head start' custom-code region). Text: if(!/instagram|FBAN|FBAV|FB_IAB/i.test(navigator.userAgent)){var s=document.createElement('script');s.type='speculationrules';s.textContent=JSON.stringify({"prefetch":[{"tag":"mpa-prefetch-eager","where":{"and":[{"href_matches":"/*"},{"not":{"href_matches":"<current path>"}}]},"eagerness":"eager"}]});document.head.appendChild(s)}. It is inserted ~1.7-2.3 s into load. In the checker's Chromium 158 with phone emulation, 'eager' fires for each same-origin link that enters the viewport (header ticker stories, footer menu, story cards); the off-canvas drawer links and the hidden Wix menu were not fetched. Each HTML document is 465-503 KB compressed (see separate HTML-weight finding), so every link costs about half a megabyte. Repeats come from #fragment variants of the same page (#roster, #schedule, #podcasts, #gbm-lp-search, /#community) and from the custom header/ticker removing and re-inserting its links during startup. The rule is absent on /pricing-plans/subscribe, /tags and the 404 page.
findings.fixDetail:
Add to a HEAD custom embed (first thing in embed 9c457b7a 'GBM - Readability and speed fixes v1', or its own small embed), 700 characters:
<script id="gbm-spec-calm-v1">(function(){try{if(!matchMedia('(max-width:820px),(pointer:coarse)').matches)return;function calm(s){if(!s||s.type!=='speculationrules'||s.getAttribute('data-gbm'))return;var t=s.textContent;if(t.indexOf('"eagerness":"eager"')<0)return;var n=document.createElement('script');n.type='speculationrules';n.setAttribute('data-gbm','1');n.textContent=t.replace(/"eagerness":"eager"/g,'"eagerness":"conservative"');s.replaceWith(n);}document.querySelectorAll('script[type=speculationrules]').forEach(calm);new MutationObserver(function(m){m.forEach(function(r){r.addedNodes.forEach(function(x){if(x.nodeType===1&&x.tagName==='SCRIPT')calm(x);});});}).observe(document,{childList:true,subtree:true});}catch(e){}})();</script>
It swaps Wix's rule for the same rule with eagerness 'conservative' (prefetch starts when the reader touches a link), on phones/touch devices only; desktop keeps Wix's hover behaviour. Rollback = delete the script.
findings.fixRisk: Low. Taps lose the head start of an already-prefetched page (they still get a prefetch from touch-down). Depends on Wix keeping the literal "eagerness":"eager" string; if Wix changes it the script does nothing (fails safe). The matchMedia guard was not in the staged run (the staged script ran unconditionally in touch emulation). Real iPhone Safari may not act on speculation rules at all, so the measured waste applies for certain to Chrome/Android/Edge/Samsung browsers.
findings.stagedResult: Staged with GB_INIT (same replace-after-insert logic, MutationObserver on document): /contact @390 11,626 KB/200 req -> 2,506 KB/159 req, 0 prefetched documents; / @390 17,731 KB/293 req -> 4,737 KB/221 req, 0 prefetched documents. A second variant (rewriting before insertion) gave the same: 2,501 KB and 4,735 KB. LCP unchanged (contact 1.65 s -> 2.0 s within run-to-run noise; home 2.80 s -> 2.75 s).

findings.title: Roster page downloads about 377 MB of player headshots (5-6 MB PNG each, shown 33-64 px wide)
findings.symptom: Outside my page list but linked from the homepage scoreboard ('Roster' -> /roster), the header, the menu drawer and the footer ('Roster', 'Scores & Schedule'). One phone visit that scrolls the roster transferred 391,924 KB in 361 requests: 117 images from dxbhsrqyrr690.cloudfront.net = 377,269 KB. Largest single files 6,016 KB (Miller_F.png), 5,917 KB, 5,560 KB. The images are 1500 px wide originals displayed at 33 px and 64 px (11.7x to 22.7x oversized). They are lazy-loaded, so a reader pays as they scroll, but every screenful is tens of MB on cellular.
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/d3/roster-390.json (kb 391924; hosts; biggest; oversized list nat 1500 / shown 33 and 64); staged result /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-phone/d13/roster-390.json
findings.cause: The roster renderer (container #gbm-rosterpage, images img.r-ph, 240 img elements; loaded by embed 72b6a528 'GBM - Football Roster v1 (live roster page, /roster)', head comment GBM_ROSTER_V1 src=16df2e794b1df12a9c10319277f65f671aec0d95) hot-links the official athletics site's full-resolution PNG headshots (https://dxbhsrqyrr690.cloudfront.net/sidearm.nextgen.sites/gatorzone.com/images/...png) with no resizing.
findings.fixDetail:
Best fix (in the roster data/bundle that embed 72b6a528 loads): emit thumbnail URLs instead of originals, e.g. 'https://images.sidearmdev.com/resize?url='+encodeURIComponent(originalUrl)+'&width=160&type=webp', or copy the headshots into Wix Media and use /v1/fill/w_160,h_213,q_80 URLs.
Stopgap that was staged and works, as a HEAD embed limited to the roster page:
<script id="gbm-roster-thumbs-v1">(function(){if(!/^\/(roster|post\/florida-gators-2026-roster)/.test(location.pathname))return;var RX=/^https:\/\/dxbhsrqyrr690\.cloudfront\.net\//;function c(u){return'https://images.sidearmdev.com/resize?url='+encodeURIComponent(u)+'&width=160&type=webp'}var sa=Element.prototype.setAttribute;Element.prototype.setAttribute=function(n,v){if(this.tagName==='IMG'&&n==='src'&&RX.test(String(v)))v=c(String(v));return sa.call(this,n,v)};var d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLImageElement.prototype,'src');Object.defineProperty(HTMLImageElement.prototype,'src',{configurable:true,enumerable:true,get:function(){return d.get.call(this)},set:function(v){d.set.call(this,RX.test(String(v))?c(String(v)):v)}});function f(i){var u=i.getAttribute('src');if(u&&RX.test(u))i.setAttribute('src',u)}new MutationObserver(function(m){m.forEach(function(r){r.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){if(n.nodeType!==1)return;if(n.tagName==='IMG')f(n);if(n.querySelectorAll)n.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(f)})})}).observe(document,{childList:true,subtree:true})})();</script>
findings.fixRisk: The stopgap patches img.src handling on that one page and depends on a third-party resize endpoint (images.sidearmdev.com) staying available; if it stops answering, headshots break (cards still render). The path guard was not in the staged run (staged script ran unguarded on /roster). Using another organisation's headshots at all is an owner/rights decision; the bundle fix with images in Wix Media removes that dependency.
findings.stagedResult: Staged with GB_INIT on /roster @390: 391,924 KB -> 13,743 KB total; the 117 headshot requests went 377,269 KB -> 467 KB (images.sidearmdev.com), 240 src rewrites, 0 broken images, thumbnails arrive 160x213 for 33-64 px slots. Most of the remaining 13.7 MB is the prefetch problem (9,663 KB).

findings.title: Latest page: the window itself cannot scroll (body is the scroll box) because html has overflow-x:clip

findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gatorbait-media-redesign/cd3b0a89-2678-5856-96f6-cbc2d6d437c6/scratchpad/audit/out-core-desktop/scrolltest/gatorbait-media-blogs-1366.json and .../scrolltest/gatorbait-media-blogs-768.json (custom.html overflow-x clip, scrollHeight = viewport; custom.afterWindowScrollTo600 sy=0; custom.afterBodyScrollTop600 bodyST=600; custom.rules lists the source rules). (body keeps overflow-x:clip, which then applies to the viewport). Better still: drop 'html' from the two selectors in style#gbm-np-hold.
